This creates a chain of interactions where Perphenazine may indirectly affect Cyp2c8 through its role in causing Hepatitis A, which in turn may alter the metabolic capacity of Cyp2c8. The lowest common ancestor of these entities is Organonitrogen Heterocyclic Compound, suggesting a broader biochemical pathway. The evidence indicates a possible indirect relationship between Perphenazine and Cyp2c8, mediated through Hepatitis A and Clopidogrel.
